name: Hook templates (fill with niche specifics)
rules: Never open cold traffic with the brand name unless the brand IS the spectacle.
Replace bracket tokens with concrete nouns from the brief.
Prefer scenes, formats, and sensations over abstractions.
For viral: signal the format in the first line or frame.
For high-production: signal craft/world in the first frame — no logo spam.

hooks.template: I wasted [time/money] on [failed approach] before I learned [mechanism].
If your [asset] has [symptom], don’t [common wrong fix] — that usually causes [worse outcome].
[Unexpected visual of problem or craft] + on-screen: [3–5 word label]
[City/region] [specialty] that actually [specific proof].
The [N]-step way to fix [problem] without [painful tradeoff]…
‘[Exact customer sentence].’ — then smash cut to the result.
Unpopular opinion: [belief that explains your wedge].
BEFORE: [blunt problem state]. (No VO needed.)
Start on the satisfying motion already happening — [action].
Use [trend format], punchline = [product truth in one line].
POV: you finally [desired identity state]…
Wait — that’s not how [domain] works…
Myth: [common belief]. Here’s what actually happens…
Character already in the absurd situation: [setup line].
GRWM for [occasion] — and the one product I won’t skip.
How much would you pay for [outcome]?
[ChallengeName]: [rule in one line]. Duet this.
Part 1 — I didn’t expect this…
Save this before you [action].
